name: Jev Social
six_word_summary: Route social research through real browsers
who: Maintained by socai-io; Jev selects typed operations and socai executes the browser work.
what: Searches Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn, streams captured evidence, and produces a source-linked report.
where: Runs as a loopback Node.js application and CLI on the user's machine.
when: Use it for bounded, read-only social research where posts, comments, profiles, media, and source links must remain inspectable.
why: Separates model judgment from code-owned validation and browser execution while preserving partial evidence instead of inventing success.
with: Requires Node.js 22+, an OpenRouter key with Jev access, and a compatible socai CLI connected to the user's Chrome.
watch: MIT-licensed and maintained by socai-io. Sends decision context to OpenRouter and uses local Chrome and socai with the user's existing platform sessions. Live sites may rate-limit, challenge, or return partial results.
